subject: Request for trial extension + promotional credits — FinTechPlus integration delay
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechplus.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura James <laura.james@fintechplus.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial extension request — integration blocked by infra changes

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We started the integration over the weekend but ran into an internal networking change that blocked our dev environment from reaching the Redwood endpoints. Our infra team is on it, but they estimate a 2–3 week remediation window because they need to update VPC peering and run an internal security review.

We were planning to evaluate Redwood in prod over the next 14 days and the current trial will expire before our fixes are complete. Can you confirm whether you can extend our trial period and provide a small promotional credit for the evaluation period?

A few details that might help:
- Seat: 3 API keys (engineering + product)
- Expected token usage during evaluation: ~1.2M tokens (prefix-heavy)
- Use case: conversational customer support + summary generation for transactions

Attached is our network diagram (network_topology.png) and the SOC2 questionnaire your security team requested earlier. If needed we can jump on a quick call with our infra lead.

Appreciate any flexibility — we want to complete the pilot and move to a paid plan if results are solid.

Best,
Samir
VP of Engineering
FinTechPlus
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechplus.com>
Cc: Laura James <laura.james@fintechplus.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration blocked by infra changes

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the diagram + SOC2 questionnaire. Sorry to hear about the peering change; totally understand the need for extra time. I can request a 30-day trial extension and propose a promotional credit to cover the evaluation usage while you validate in your infra environment.

I'll loop in my manager (Marissa) and our finance lead (Aditya) to confirm the amount and any terms — would $5k in credits + an additional 30 days work for you? If you prefer a different number, let me know what your ideal coverage would be.

Next steps:
- I'll send an internal approval request now and aim to come back with a formal terms PDF by EOD tomorrow.
- If your infra lead wants to chat about connectivity, I can arrange a short technical bridge with our solutions engineer.

Subject: FW: Trial extension request — FinTechPlus (approval request)

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Requesting approval for a promotional trial extension and credits for FinTechPlus (DEAL-7812). Summary below:

Customer: FinTechPlus (Samir Gupta, VP Eng)
Ask: 30-day trial extension + promotional credit to cover evaluation (~1.2M tokens expected)
Rationale:
- Customer had planned to validate in a live-like env this cycle but a VPC peering/security change stalled their dev environment.
- Estimated ARR if pilot succeeds: $120k/year (product-led expansion likely across two business units).
- Competitive urgency: they are evaluating two other providers; demonstrating stable integration early increases win probability.

Proposed promo: $5,000 in platform credits to be applied to usage during the extended trial window. Requesting Marissa's sign-off and Aditya to flag any finance/contract constraints.

Attachments: promo_terms_draft.pdf (I drafted simple T&Cs — link below).

Can we get sign-off by EOD so I can respond to the customer tomorrow?

Thanks,
Monica

---
[Attachment: promo_terms_draft.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Monica —

Thank you for the clear summary. Approve 30-day extension and up to $5,000 in promotional credits for FinTechPlus. Please include the following in the terms:
- Credits expire at end of the extended trial window and cannot be converted to cash.
- Customer must sign the standard promo addendum stating evaluation intent; legal has pre-approved the template.
- If usage exceeds the credit during the trial, normal overage rates apply.

Aditya — please confirm accounting can provision the credit against DEAL-7812 and let Monica know the internal code to use. If finance needs any paperwork, flag here.

Samir —

Good news: we've approved a 30-day trial extension and $5,000 in platform credits for FinTechPlus. Attached is the promo_terms_approved.pdf with the brief addendum your procurement team can sign. Aditya (cc) confirmed finance will provision the credit under internal code PROMO-DEAL-7812; accounting will apply it to your trial billing.

What this means for you:
- Trial end date extended to 2026-04-14 (30 days from original expiration).
- $5,000 credit applied to usage during the extended trial; overages billed at standard rates.
- SOC2 questionnaire received — our security team will follow up if they need anything else.

If you'd like, we can schedule a short technical sync between your infra lead and our solutions engineer (30 min) to accelerate the VPC peering validation. Would Wednesday or Thursday this week work?

Attachments: promo_terms_approved.pdf, SOC2_questionnaire.pdf

Thanks for the patience — looking forward to seeing the pilot results.

Best,
Monica Patel
